Photo · BBQ on the grill

Welcome to The American Backyard

Photo · ribs platter

We bring the classic, smokey flavors of an authentic backyard barbecue straight to the heart of Davao City. The American Backyard is built around great food, massive portions, and the laid-back comfort of a weekend cookout.

We specialize in mouth-watering American comfort food, serving up everything from fall-off-the-bone ribs and perfectly seared steaks to juicy, stacked burgers, crispy chicken wings, and savory sausages. Whether you are craving a low-and-slow smoked barbecue or a hearty platter to share, our kitchen pairs premium meats with bold, signature sauces to satisfy your biggest cravings.

What started as a passion for genuine Western-style grilling has grown into a favorite dining destination for Davaoeños. We pride ourselves on creating a casual, welcoming atmosphere where families, friends, and food lovers can gather, unwind, and feast.

No pretension, no fuss—just excellent meats, ice-cold drinks, and good vibes. Come on over to our backyard!
